note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, so that section is not included; the length of the right mandible and the pronotum width of the worker were disturbed by line breaks and quotation marks in the scan and are not transcribed; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, slightly less than twice as long as wide, fontanelle at about one quarter of the length of the head capsule from the anterior end, left mandible strongly twisted with a broad, spoon-shaped apex; total length 6.5–8.0 mm. Worker head capsule subcircular, antennae 14-segmented, total length 3.90–4.63 mm. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to pale brown, antennae pale brown to brown, labrum brown with a hyaline midregion, mandibles reddish brown to dark brown, the right mandible slightly paler than the left; thorax paler than head, abdomen and legs yellowish white; head sparsely setose, body densely setose; total length 6.5–8.0. Head capsule subrectangular, slightly less than twice as long as wide (length to mandibular base 2.45–3.00, width 1.45–1.60); sides nearly parallel, slightly narrowed in front of the antennae; frons weakly inclined forward; coronal suture a dark line between the fontanelle and the posterior margin of the head. Fontanelle minute, circular, with a small duct leading inward, at the base of the frons, about one quarter of the length of the head capsule from its anterior end (distance from posterior head margin to fontanelle 2.03–2.07, ratio of this distance to head length 0.75–0.78). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and clavate, segment 4 shortest. Labrum subquadrate, sides convex (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.28–0.35), weakly asymmetrical, anterior margin nearly straight or slightly convex, anterolateral angles with minute points. Mandibles strongly asymmetrical, shorter than the head (left 1.75–2.00, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.65–0.68); left mandible strongly twisted, with a broad, spoon-shaped apex; right mandible blade-like, slightly curved outward near the tip. Postmentum long, clavate, with a long narrow waist (length 1.57–1.83, maximum width 0.47–0.50, waist width 0.20–0.23). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe strongly upturned, anterior margin rounded without concavity, posterior margin convex without concavity; mesonotum narrower than pronotum; metanotum equal in width to or slightly wider than pronotum.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule milk-white, antennae, legs and thorax slightly paler, abdomen greyish through the gut contents; head and body moderately setose; total length 3.90–4.63. Head capsule subcircular, widest near the antennae (length to mandibular base 0.83–0.97, maximum width 1.03–1.13). Frontal plate large, oval, appearing as a white spot (diameter 0.13–0.16). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 generally smaller, sometimes about equal to segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus arched, less than half as long as wide. Labrum, mandibles and pronotum as in the genus (pronotum length 0.25–0.27).
